notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least five creatures without summoning sickness.
description:
Activate five creatures you control by tapping them, adding {4}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Searing Touch to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control six or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.
